generation.scope: For a smooth plane cubic in a fixed trace metric the exact obstruction to a finite independent-bracket mixed seed is membership of the inverse metric in one of the three other square-root Veronese surfaces of the elliptic normal sextic. Outside the exception a two-dimensional family of apolar reduced frames yields an eight-dimensional indexed-class image of finite rank-ten geometric-generic AS windows with that precise cubic. Inside the exception every apolar length-four divisor contains a length-three divisor giving a commuting plane, even with nonreduced support. A smooth exceptional cubic with nonsingular metric is computed explicitly.

open_mathematics: Resolve exceptional smooth cubics via their apolar triples: normalize a reduced orthogonal triangle, determine all possible complementary symmetric planes when the first net contains a Cartan plane, and study the remaining inverse-commutator and all-degree regularity conditions.
